title: How do I change the app to view jpg images?
creator: mitch37
content:
I set the app to open .jpg images as mspaint.exe and now every time I try to open a jpg I get an error message from mspaint saying "unable to create new document".

In the settings there's a list of attachments with options, but I can't find one for jpg images. How can I change the setting?

title: アドレス帳やメールで敬称（接頭称）の表示場所がおかしい
creator: shige.dayo
content: • 起きている問題： アドレス帳やメール表示において、名前の表示形式を「敬称（接頭称）＋名前」にしているにもかかわらず、「名前＋敬称」の順（あるいは英語順のまま）で表示されてしまう。 • 本来あるべき姿： 日本語環境では、接頭辞（Mr.やDr.など）は名前の前に正しく配置される、もしくは日本語の「様（接尾辞）」に合わせた並び順が選択できるべきである。

title: Need to recover 2 yrs of emails after fresh install of Ubuntu
creator: netsurfau
content:
Due to issues with upgrading from Ubuntu 24.04.1 to 26.04.1, I decided to just start from scratch with a new clean install.

After finalising the install, I copied across my Thunderbird data to the new partition, merging directories as the data copied across. But, somewhere in the transfer I lost about the last two years emails, with only emails up until 12/24 being available.

There are a lot a important emails I need to recover, and I'm guessing they're still on my PC, in the old partition, and I desperately need help to recover them.
